divergences.upstreamResult: React component handlers conventionally observe per-keystroke edits through synthetic onChange.
divergences.octaneResult: Every Shadcn component base exposes native per-keystroke edits through onInput; native change retains commit semantics.
divergences.rationale: Octane uses delegated native DOM events rather than React's synthetic change event layer.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers migrating input handlers use onInput for per-keystroke behavior.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Attach per-keystroke handlers with onInput and reserve onChange for native commit behavior.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces React-compatible synthetic input events.

divergences.upstreamResult: React Radix asChild composes an opaque React element child.
divergences.octaneResult: Shadcn asChild composes an Octane element descriptor created with createElement.
divergences.rationale: Octane's Radix Slot contract operates on descriptors rather than opaque compiled children.
divergences.consumerImpact: Direct asChild children must be element descriptors.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass createElement output when authoring a direct asChild child.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane Slot gains compiled-child composition.

divergences.upstreamResult: The Shadcn CLI resolves IconPlaceholder according to the consumer's configured icon library.
divergences.octaneResult: The published Octane source resolves icon placeholders to @octanejs/lucide at port time.
divergences.rationale: This registry-first package currently publishes one resolved component source flavor.
divergences.consumerImpact: Direct package imports use Lucide icons regardless of another Shadcn CLI icon-library preference.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Override exposed icon slots where supported or use the emitted registry source as a customization point.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when registry emission supports selectable icon libraries.

divergences.upstreamResult: The upstream Sonner wrapper reads theme state from next-themes.
divergences.octaneResult: The Octane Sonner wrapper accepts an ordinary theme prop and defaults it to system.
divergences.rationale: The Octane package does not depend on the React-specific next-themes provider.
divergences.consumerImpact: Applications pass theme explicitly instead of receiving it from next-themes.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Thread the application's current theme into the Toaster theme prop.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if an Octane theme-provider contract is introduced.
